pages.text: Burn Mandrake Root in a Witches' Oven with an Empty Jar available. It produces Wood Ash and has a 75 percent chance to bottle Liquid Witchcraft. This is a foundation for altars, shelves and magical threads.

Saplings provide other oven fumes: Oak Spirit, Spruce Heart, Birch Soul and more. Ordinary crafting returns an Empty Jar from fume items. Machine recipes specify their own outputs; do not assume an extra jar appears automatically.
